capabilities: Schedule long-form reading topics with progress-aware A-Factor intervals
Create extracts from selected text, the clipboard, or PDFs and link them to parent sources
Create and review flashcards with built-in FSRS, Anki via Flashcards, or Spaced Repetition
Manage a mixed reading-and-card queue with a knowledge tree and analytics dashboard
Open vault or external PDFs in an integrated reader with saved read points
extras: Desktop-only: the integrated PDF reader relies on Electron and Node APIs unavailable on mobile. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Local-first: no telemetry, accounts, or network requests.
intentEvidence: See SuperMemo workflow alignment for a feature-by-feature comparison and the intentional differences.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read long sources in scheduled portions and convert selected passages into spaced-repetition review material.

relations.evidence: For Anki, install Flashcards by Reuseman and AnkiConnect
For the SR option, install Spaced Repetition.
Anki cards stay in Anki's review queue.

requires.name: Flashcards by Reuseman or Spaced Repetition

summary: Incremental reading toolkit that schedules long-form reading topics, creates linked extracts, and turns them into flashcards via FSRS, Anki, or Spaced Repetition.
